draft.subject: your intake coordinator role
draft.body:
Hi Beth,

Saw Hollis & Grant is hiring an intake coordinator to run new-client calls and conflict checks. More intake usually means more client detail passing through more tools.

We built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture.

Worth a look?

claims.text: Hollis & Grant is hiring an intake coordinator to run new-client calls and conflict checks
We built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture

evidence.text: Intake Coordinator. Run new-client calls, conflict checks and engagement letters for our estate planning team.
Hollis & Grant LLP adds a business law practice.
Our 16 attorneys handle estate planning, business law and real estate.

facts.wording: Built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture (Legal AI).
ABA Formal Opinion 512 says a lawyer needs the client's informed consent before putting client information into a self-learning generative AI tool.
A 17+ person team of engineers, AI specialists and analysts, based in San Jose.
